changelog: fix: 2.9.26's clean-up deleted a good figure (12_upgma_jaccard). The check for a figure left half-drawn compared device numbers only. After the jaccard tree was saved and closed, ggplot opened R's default device on its own to build the next figure, it took the same number, and the check took it for the unfinished jaccard tree and deleted the PNG. dev.off() now forgets the figure it closes, so only a figure that really failed is removed. Reproduced (file deleted with 2.9.26, kept now). Also: the ANCOMBC2 volcano says which contrast it is and how many taxa were tested and significant, and its key reads 'not significant' / 'q < 0.05' instead of FALSE/TRUE. Checked against the 2.9.26 render: UPGMA trees coloured by group, 17_beta_heatmap_bray present, species counts without 'Unclassified' (Species 32 vs Genus 89 for Pre-R1), volcano drawn.

previous.changelog: fix: review of the first full R re-render (45 figures). (1) UPGMA dendrograms (05_beta_UPGMA, 12_upgma_*) now colour each sample's branch and name by group with a key. 12_upgma used rect.hclust() boxes coloured 'by group', but the boxes are clusters: with Pre-R2 and R2 clustering together, the 'feed' box held a Reactor sample. (2) The same group colour everywhere: group_pal() assigns colours in metadata order, used by the beta heatmaps (05, 17) and dendrograms; 05_beta_heatmap had pheatmap's default green/pink. (3) Taxa detected per sample (22b) no longer counts 'Unclassified' as a taxon. The taxonomy reaching viz_pipeline.R is already cleaned, so every genus without a species added one 'species' (Species 128 > Genus 106 for Pre-R1). (4) No more blank PNGs: a figure that fails half-way is closed and deleted instead of delivered blank, and a device left open by a failed figure is closed before the next one starts drawing into it. The ANCOMBC2 volcano picked the intercept's columns and drew nothing; it now takes the group contrast and skips with a reason when no taxon has both numbers (usual at 2 samples per group). (5) The editor names the figures R skipped or failed, with R's reason, after a render; the full log is kept in edit_charts/r_render.log (17_beta_heatmap_bray was missing from this render and its reason was only in memory). (6) Taxonomy heatmaps are less tall per row. Verified: UPGMA, both heatmaps, the failure clean-up and the species count rendered/tested in R on the U2BI-139 tables; viz_pipeline.R parses; main.py parses; 18 drivers, 592 checks.
